title: 一致性哈希环：虚拟节点与增删节点的 key 迁移率实测

基准集群 = N0,N1,N2,N3

code:
import zlib
from bisect import bisect_right

VN = 150


def h(s):
    return zlib.crc32(s.encode("utf-8"))


class Ring:
    def __init__(self, nodes, vn=VN):
        self.vn = vn
        self.pts = []
        self.owner = {}
        for n in nodes:
            self.add(n)

    def add(self, n):
        for i in range(self.vn):
            p = h("%s#%d" % (n, i))
            self.pts.append(p)
            self.owner[p] = n
        self.pts.sort()

    def remove(self, n):
        drop = set(h("%s#%d" % (n, i)) for i in range(self.vn))
        self.pts = [p for p in self.pts if p not in drop]
        for p in drop:
            self.owner.pop(p, None)

    def get(self, key):
        p = h(key)
        i = bisect_right(self.pts, p)
        if i == len(self.pts):
            i = 0
        return self.owner[self.pts[i]]


KEYS = ["key:%05d" % i for i in range(10000)]
BASE = ["N0", "N1", "N2", "N3"]


def counts_of(ring, keys):
    c = {}
    for k in keys:
        o = ring.get(k)
        c[o] = c.get(o, 0) + 1
    return c


def spread(c, names):
    v = [c.get(n, 0) for n in names]
    mean = sum(v) / len(v)
    sd = (sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in v) / len(v)) ** 0.5
    return max(v) - min(v), sd


print("=== 一致性哈希环（含虚拟节点）===")
print("key 数 = %d, 每个物理节点虚拟节点数 = %d" % (len(KEYS), VN))
print("基准集群 = " + ",".join(BASE))
print()

r4 = Ring(BASE)
before = [r4.get(k) for k in KEYS]
r4.add("N4")
after = [r4.get(k) for k in KEYS]
mv_add = sum(1 for a, b in zip(before, after) if a != b)

r5 = Ring(BASE + ["N4"])
before2 = [r5.get(k) for k in KEYS]
r5.remove("N4")
after2 = [r5.get(k) for k in KEYS]
mv_del = sum(1 for a, b in zip(before2, after2) if a != b)

print("[增 1 节点] 4 -> 5")
print("  受影响 key = %d / %d = %.4f" % (mv_add, len(KEYS), mv_add / len(KEYS)))
print("  理论值 1/N = 1/5 = 0.2000")
print("  判据 |实测-理论| < 0.02 : %s" % (abs(mv_add / len(KEYS) - 0.2) < 0.02))
print("[删 1 节点] 5 -> 4")
print("  受影响 key = %d / %d = %.4f" % (mv_del, len(KEYS), mv_del / len(KEYS)))
print("  判据 |实测-理论| < 0.02 : %s" % (abs(mv_del / len(KEYS) - 0.2) < 0.02))
print()

names = BASE + ["N4"]
r5full = Ring(names)
c150 = counts_of(r5full, KEYS)
c1 = counts_of(Ring(names, vn=1), KEYS)
d150, s150 = spread(c150, names)
d1, s1 = spread(c1, names)

print("负载均衡：5 节点分摊 10000 个 key")
print("  虚拟节点=%-3d 各节点 key 数 = %s" % (1, [c1.get(n, 0) for n in names]))
print("  虚拟节点=%-3d 各节点 key 数 = %s" % (VN, [c150.get(n, 0) for n in names]))
print("  极差: %d -> %d" % (d1, d150))
print("  标准差: %.1f -> %.1f" % (s1, s150))
print("  判据 增加虚拟节点后标准差显著下降 : %s" % (s150 < s1 / 5))
print()
print("结论1：增删节点只影响邻近弧段，实测迁移率 %.4f 接近理论 1/N = 0.2000。"
      % (mv_add / len(KEYS)))
print("结论2：虚拟节点数 1 -> %d，负载标准差 %.1f -> %.1f，热点倾斜被抹平。"
      % (VN, s1, s150))
